label: Назад
description: A 10-sentence usage card for назад (back, backwards).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direction of motion. 'Назад' means backwards and modifies the imperative 'сделай', marking the direction of the steps. It shows real movement away from the front, toward the rear.
Strategic focus: Reverse movement. 'Назад' modifies 'поехала' to show the car moving in reverse. The adverb marks the backward direction of travel and follows the verb naturally.
Strategic focus: Turning the gaze backward. 'Назад' modifies 'посмотрел' to show the look directed behind. The pairing with 'обернулся' makes the backward orientation vivid and physical.
Strategic focus: Returning an object. 'Назад' modifies the imperative 'верни', reinforcing the idea of giving something back. Here it stresses the return to the original owner.
Strategic focus: Running back. 'Назад' modifies 'побежали' to mark the backward, returning direction of the run. It works with 'к дому' to show both the direction and the goal.
Strategic focus: Time in the past. 'Назад' here marks time, meaning ago, following the duration 'три года'. In this temporal use it always comes after the time expression, not before it.
Strategic focus: Stepping back politely. 'Назад' modifies the imperative 'отойди' to mark moving away to the rear. Softened by 'пожалуйста', it is a polite request to give space.
Strategic focus: Sudden reverse. 'Назад' modifies 'тронулся' to show the train starting to move backward. The adverb fixes the direction, while 'вдруг' adds the suddenness.

missions.phrase: Мы пошли назад той же дорогой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Retracing a path. 'Назад' modifies 'пошли' to mark the return journey. Combined with 'той же дорогой', it shows movement back along the same route.

Strategic focus: Backward versus forward. 'Назад' modifies 'оглядывайся' to mark looking behind, set in direct contrast with 'вперёд'. The pair captures the opposition between past and future direction.
